QuestInfo.name: The Bowman's Next Journey
QuestInfo.0: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Archer, I feel the urge to learn more.
QuestInfo.1: Does #b#p221##k of #b#m10001000##k have even greater lessons to teach me?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p221##k said that if I can pass her test, she'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.

0.0: Finally, I've reached level 30! It hasn't been easy, but now I'm confident I can stand as a true Bowman who won't lose to anyone. Still... Is this really enough? The world is vast, and I find myself wanting to learn more.
0.1: I should probably visit #b#p221##k in #b#m10001000##k again. She might be able to teach me things even greater things.

1.0: Hmmm... You have grown a lot since I last saw you. I don't see the weakling I saw before, and instead, you look much more like a Bowman now.
1.1: No need for a long explanation--you're here to learn more, aren't you? Seeing someone like you rekindles my own spirit.
